_comment: Disembark (Tools): removes everything one customer's enrolment created in the Temenos Digital DBXDB schema (MySQL), keyed by one core customer ID (CIF). The engine holds no table names: every lookup and delete is listed here. Order matters: resolve steps run first and their IDs are held, then delete steps run top to bottom (children first, anchors last) in ONE transaction. A step with confirmed=false is listed but never run; switch it on only after review. Unknown keys stop the server with a clear message.
_origin: Ported from the DM Studio un-enrolment module (rollback_config.json, validated against a real UAT copy) plus the product team's customer delete list. Steps that came only from the product list and touch payment history are off by default.

resolveSteps.name: contractId
resolveSteps.sql: SELECT contractId FROM contractcorecustomers WHERE coreCustomerId = :cif

resolveSteps.name: customerId
resolveSteps.sql: SELECT customerId FROM contractcustomers WHERE coreCustomerId = :cif

resolveSteps.name: signatoryGroupId
resolveSteps.sql: SELECT signatoryGroupId FROM signatorygroup WHERE coreCustomerId = :cif

resolveSteps.name: approvalMatrixId
resolveSteps.sql: SELECT cam.approvalMatrixId FROM customerapprovalmatrix cam JOIN contractcustomers cc ON cam.customerId = cc.customerId WHERE cc.coreCustomerId = :cif

resolveSteps.name: customRoleId
resolveSteps.sql: SELECT customRoleId FROM contractcustomrole WHERE coreCustomerId = :cif

resolveSteps.name: addressId
resolveSteps.sql: SELECT Address_id FROM customeraddress WHERE Customer_id IN (SELECT customerId FROM contractcustomers WHERE coreCustomerId = :cif) UNION SELECT addressId FROM contractaddress WHERE contractId IN (SELECT contractId FROM contractcorecustomers WHERE coreCustomerId = :cif)

resolveSteps.name: accountId
resolveSteps.sql: SELECT Account_id FROM customeraccounts WHERE Customer_id IN (SELECT customerId FROM contractcustomers WHERE coreCustomerId = :cif)

resolveSteps.name: userName
resolveSteps.sql: SELECT UserName FROM customer WHERE id IN (SELECT customerId FROM contractcustomers WHERE coreCustomerId = :cif)

resolveSteps.name: customerRequestId
resolveSteps.sql: SELECT id FROM customerrequest WHERE Customer_id IN (SELECT customerId FROM contractcustomers WHERE coreCustomerId = :cif)

checks.label: Login shared with another CIF
checks.sql: SELECT customerId AS item, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT coreCustomerId ORDER BY coreCustomerId SEPARATOR ', ') AS others FROM contractcustomers WHERE customerId IN (:customerId) AND coreCustomerId <> :cif GROUP BY customerId
checks.message: This login is also linked to other CIFs on its contract (for example one person with access to several legal entities of the same company). Deleting it removes that person's access to the other CIFs too.

checks.label: Contract shared with another CIF
checks.sql: SELECT contractId AS item, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT coreCustomerId ORDER BY coreCustomerId SEPARATOR ', ') AS others FROM contractcorecustomers WHERE contractId IN (:contractId) AND coreCustomerId <> :cif GROUP BY contractId
checks.message: This contract also holds other CIFs. Contract-side deletes remove the whole contract, so those CIFs lose it too. Stop unless that is intended.
